page.notes: Printed text is in a rough, worn state; several words are uncertain and were copied as best read without marking, notably "eupata", "pō.ifex", "Lothi in-estus", "impost-" and "Ana=". The printer's hyphens and "=" signs are kept as printed. Page numbers sit at the right of each entry and stay on their line. Entries run in two alignments on the scan; they are transcribed line by line in printed order. Some lines are cut off at the foot of the scan and may continue beyond the image.
